bükü: bü- — to be; participle -kü, 'being, that is' (the Ming 有的) (verb, participle) [有的]
köġü: köġü — son (a short form of köġün) (noun) [兒]
kižü: ki- — to do, make; converb -žü, 'making' (verb, converb) [做着]
erin: eri- — to seek, look for; converb -n, 'seeking' (verb, converb) [尋]
edün: edün — these (plural of ene; Ming 這些每) (demonstrative pronoun) [這些每]
baraγsan: bara- — to be finished, ruined (here transitive, 'to ruin'); past participle -γsan, 'one who has ruined' (verb, participle) [廢盡的] · also intransitive, 'one that has been ruined, gone to ruin' (Ming 了的, 了了的), of a people
moṅγol-un: Monγol — the Mongols (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars'); genitive -un, 'of the Mongols' (name + case, back-vowel form; written with a dotted ṅ) [達達的]
žamuqa-luγ̇a: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name (personal name); -luγ̇a comitative: with, together with (back-vowel form; Ming 一同) [人名 一同]
altan: altan — gold (noun); a man's name, as a son's name (Altan); and in Altan Qaγan the title of the Jin emperor, where the Ming glosses 金 'gold, Jin' (noun, personal name, title) [(兒)名; 金]
bidan-dur: bida — we (inclusive); stem extension -n + dative-locative -dur, 'to us' (pronoun + case suffix) [咱行] · also, with the Ming 俺行 (not only 咱行), 'to us'; the Ming alternates 俺 and 咱 for the same inclusive form
daižižu: daiži- — to turn against, to turn hostile (from dain 'enemy'; Ming 反); converb -žu, 'turning hostile' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [反走着]
monγol: Monγol — the Mongols, a people (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars', as in the published monγol-i) (name) [達達]
modun: modun — tree, trees, wood (noun; Ming 樹) [樹]
bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
an-i: an — them (third-person plural oblique stem, inferred); accusative -i (pronoun + accusative) [他每行]
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
odču: od- — to go; converb -ču, 'going' (verb, converb) [去着] · also od- 'to reach, get to' (Ming 得着 'getting') [得着]
morin-u: morin — horse; genitive -u, 'of the horse' (noun + case) [馬的]
že: že — particle, 'indeed, so' (the Ming 也者 'so be it') [(也者︀)] · also 'so, very well' (Ming 那般), a particle that opens a sentence · also the word of assent, 'yes' (Ming 應許聲 'a sound of agreement'), answering a proposal · also after a name, the shouted call (Temüžin že, Ming 也者; the force is uncertain) · also a closing 'indeed' (Ming 也者), as in ta ečiges köġüd-ün tusa ažuγui že
böġesü: bü- — to be; conditional böġesü, 'if it be, if it is that' [有來] · also glossed 有呵, with 呵 the marker of 'if' (Ming 有來 or 有呵); with ele, 'if only … be'
köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
köġün-i: köġün — son; accusative -i, 'the son (object)' (noun + case) [兒子 行] · also with Ming 子 行, 'the son' as object
ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not' · also before a bare stem (ülü buča 'does not conceal') and a converb (ülü jaγaran 'not hurrying')
kēġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb; keġe- + -ġed run together and written with a long ē; Ming 說了) [說了]
qadqulduγsan: qadqu- — to fight, strike; reciprocal -ldu-; past participle -γsan, 'that which (they) fought', i.e. 'where they had fought' (verb, reciprocal participle) [厮殺︀的]
γažar-ača: γažar — place, land; ablative -ača, 'from' (noun + case; the Ming 行 is only its stock gloss) [地行]
qarin: qarin — back, again (adverb; Ming 回) [囘] · also 'tribe, division' (Ming 部 'division, section'; sense uncertain), in harban γurban qarin, 'thirteen divisions' · also read as qari- 'to return' + converb -n, 'returning' (Ming 囘)
ičuba: ič- — to withdraw, retreat (stem inferred; Ming 退); -uba: past: linking vowel -u- (uncertain) + -ba (back-vowel form) [退了]
tendēče: tende — there; ablative -ēče, 'from there' (adverb + case; long vowel from tende + -eče) [那裏自]
eče: eče — from (ablative ending, front-vowel form; the Ming has 處 'place', as 'from the place of') [處]
qalqa: qalqa — shield (noun; Ming 團牌 'round shield') [團牌]
huruγ̇u: huruγ̇u — downstream, following the course, along [順]
miṅγan: miṅγan — thousand (numeral; as a unit, a thousand-man body) [千]
žirγoγ̇an: Žirγoγ̇an — Jirqo'an, a man's name (personal name; the numeral 'six' as a name) [人名] · also written without a capital as the plain numeral žirγoγ̇an, 'six' (Ming 六), in žirγoγ̇an üdüd, 'six days'
žaγ̇ud: žaγ̇ud — hundred, plural form, 'hundreds' (numeral + plural -d; Ming 百每) [百(每)]
neġübe: neġü- — to move camp; past -be, 'moved camp' (verb, past tense) [起了]
uruγ̇ud: Uruγ̇ud — the Uru'ud, a clan name (apparently Uruγ̇udai with plural -d; a guess) [一種]
moṅγud: Moṅγud — the Mongqud, a clan name (apparently Monγutai with plural -d; a guess; Shiratori writes ṅ here and n in Monγutai) [一種]
neġüžü: neġü- — to move camp, to migrate; converb, 'moving camp' [起着]
quildar: Quildar — Quildar, a man's name; perhaps the same man as the published Qujuldar of the Mongqud (the Han differ; uncertain) (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
üdüġüj-e: üdüġüi — not yet (Ming 未); -e: dative-locative (j is a glide) [未(行)]
na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126) · also Waṅ-Qān-(n)a, 'to Wang Qan' (after a stem ending in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 人名行)
idqaγ̇asu: idqa- — to urge, persuade (stem inferred from the Ming 勸); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form; Ming 呵) [勸呵]
dobtulqu: dobtul- — to charge, hurl oneself; participle -qu, 'one who charges' (verb, participle; Ming 的) [衝的]
nögčibe: nögči- — to die (stem inferred); past -be, 'died' (verb, past tense) [死了] · also 'passed on, went on', in kēġed nögčibe 'having said, he went on' (Ming 過去了)
tabiγ̇ulba: tabi- — to let go, set loose, release (a spelling of talbi-); causative -γ̇ul-, 'make …'; past -ba, '-ed' (back-vowel form) (verb, causative past tense) [敎放了]
büjür: Büjür — Büyür, a lake or water (Ming 水名 'water name') [水名]
čidququ: čidqu- — to pour into, flow in (stem inferred from the Ming 注); participle -qu, '…ing' (verb, participle) [注的]
terge: terge — cart (noun; the first half of tergeġür 'cart-track', cut at a line end in Shiratori's text; the whole word is tergeġür; Ming 車) [車]
uṅgirad: Uṅgirad — the Ongirad (Shiratori's spelling Uṅgirad), a people or clan name (the -d is probably plural) [姓氏]
medežü: mede- — to know; converb -žü, 'knowing' (verb, converb) [知着]
žürčede-ji: Žürčedei — Jürchedei, a man's name (stem Žürčede- before a case ending); accusative -ji, 'Jürchedei (object)' (personal name + case; Ming 人名 行) [人名 行]
uruγ̇udi: Uruγ̇ud — the Uruqud, a people; with Shiratori's (i), 'the Uruqud' as object (the token left before -jan, 'one's own Uruqud'; people name + accusative; Ming 一種 自的行) [一種 自的行]
ilebe: ile- — to send; past -be, 'sent' [敎去了] · also where the Ming reads 去了 'went' (uncertain) [去了]
ilerün: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了); converb of time -rün, 'sending, when sending' (verb, converb; uncertain: here the Ming gives 去 'go', so 'going' is another possible reading) [去]
irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
erte: erte — early, in former times (adjective, adverb) [自在] · also 'beforehand, earlier' (Ming 在前) · also 'early' (Ming 早), as in manaγar erte, 'tomorrow early'
üdür-eče: üdür — day; ablative -eče, 'from the day, since the days of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [前日子]
ökin-ü: ökin — girl, daughter; genitive -ü, 'of the daughter' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [女的]
müd: müd — they (third-person plural; Ming 他每) (pronoun; the exact form is uncertain) [他每]
bulγa: bulγa — revolt, rebellion (noun; Ming 反) [反]
ileġesü: ile- — to send (the Ming glosses 去 'go'); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) sends' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [去呵]
orožuγ̇ui: oro- — to enter; narrative past -žuγ̇ui, 'went in' (verb, past; back-vowel form of -žüġüi) [入了]
an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
